commentary: Today, DCE iron ore futures opened with a slight drop, with the most-traded contract I2509 eventually closing at 703 yuan/mt, down 0.42% for the day. Traders sold goods in line with market condiƟons. Steel mills showed a strong desire to bargain down prices, with transacƟons mainly concluded at lower prices. The market transacƟon atmosphere was average. The mainstream transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes in Shandong were around 702-705 yuan/mt, down 5-8 yuan/mt from yesterday's prices. In Tangshan, the transacƟon prices of PB ﬁnes were around 710-715 yuan/mt, also down 5-8 yuan/mt from yesterday's prices. Today, aﬀected by the Middle East conﬂict, iron ore prices were in the doldrums. However, due to relaƟvely small industrial contradicƟons and fundamental support, the decline in futures prices was limited. Currently, there is an abundant supply of spot ore resources in the market, and the selling of some varieƟes at lower prices has led to the spread between futures and spot prices narrowing to parity.
